newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable in slow trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally stable in late trading on Wednesday, with demand continuing to be weak, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,390-95 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,385 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,226 exBelawan in the North Sumatran city of Medan at a tender on Tuesday.

"Trading has been slow," one trader said. "There have been no fresh leads, and players are looking to buy at below the market range. The Malaysian market has also been sluggish, maybe because of the coming Good Friday and Easter holidays."
Traders said there was no processing margin at current palm olein prices, adding that olein was due for a correction after four straight weeks of declines.
"I think it's a matter of time," one trader said. "Prices have gone down significantly and they should adjust upwards."
Traders also said the state joint marketing board had cut its crude palm oil price to 1,100 rupiah from 1,125 rupiah in the wake of the decline in local and overseas prices.
Traders said they expected the April export taxes on crude palm oil and palm olein to be lower than in March.
